diagnosis: 0.2.0 filled only slot 0 of each endpoint; the other 45 slots kept Alpha 1 II matrices

repeating one matrix per endpoint removes the per-sector rotation; the algebraic probe shows sector-to-sector differences up to about 40 degrees of hue

gamma_port.target_layout: A7C II 2.01 stock gamma table at cpapp-b.bin +0xcfa6d0, stride 576 bytes, 50 records; +0x218 tag (high byte = gamma id), +0x21c generation (5 = internal slots 0-5, 6 = internal slot 6), +0x220 max, +0x23c structural field = 2
gamma_port.routing_evidence: A7C II 2.01 stock cpapp-b.bin +0xcfa588 already holds 20 (still id, movie id) pairs; the last two are FL2=(0x30,0x30) and FL3=(0x31,0x31), i.e. Sony routes both still and movie to one id
gamma_port.conversion: A7C II record (576B) = FX2[0:0x238] + FX2[0x23c:0x244], with +0x21c generation rewritten from 3 to 5 for the slots 0-5 record; this reproduces the two records 0.4.0 already shipped with zero byte differences
gamma_port.fix: 0.5.1: generation 5 and generation 6 both carry the FX2 photo internal slot-6 curve, so the photo tone is correct whichever record the body reads
gamma_port.raw_support: A7R V research section 3: RAW 0x7806 = 2 x CP photo gamma internal slot 6, and its FL2 sample list is exactly the FX2 0xdb3500 record
gamma_port.native_module_sync: installer.so updated by equal-length byte replacement of new_0 (3872 B) and final_hashes[1] (32 B); module size stays 56864 bytes and no relocation changes

usbdev_fix.symptom: AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute '_ctx' at usb/util.py dispose_resources
usbdev_fix.root_cause: usbdev.find() returned [] when the device did not appear within the timeout, while usb.util.dispose_resources() only accepts a single Device. The crash escaped from request_service_mode() because it sat in a finally block, where exceptions are not caught by the enclosing try/except.
fix: find() now returns None (never a list); require() raises a displayable message
usbdev.dispose() ignores None, list/tuple/set and any object without _ctx
request_service_mode() returns early when the device is absent, before importing pmca
the 0336 wait loop tests "is not None" instead of relying on find() raising
transport._dispose() delegates to usbdev.dispose(); identity()/Session use require()
usbdev_fix.regression_tests: tests/test_usbdev.py (13 cases, fake usb.core/usb.util injected via sys.modules)
